The music is AI-assisted, yes, but there is still a lot of human work between the first generation and what you finally hear here: selection, arrangement, editing, effects, structure, atmosphere and many small decisions.

I also think it’s worth asking why something that moved you a moment before should suddenly lose all its value because you learned that AI was one of the tools involved. The process matters, of course, but so does the result. For me, AI is part of the toolbox, not the whole creative process.

That said, I completely understand that everyone has their own feelings about AI and art. I’m genuinely glad the music connected with you before you knew how it was made, and I appreciate you taking the time to listen and share your thoughts 🖤
